'''Unduine's''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] situated on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It served ribs from animals across sixteen different [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].
